rules.statement: The label of a transaction, such as 'partnership', does not control the true nature of the rights and liabilities created; these must be determined by examining the terms and conditions of the instrument itself.
rules.supporting_quote: "the mere affixing of a label to a transaction by the parties or by their legal advisers does not control or govern the true nature of the rights and liabilities created which have to be determined by an examination of the terms and conditions of the instrument itself."
